Class AbstractFilteringLogger

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.slf4j.spi.AbstractFilteringLogger
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoggerDecoratorService.DepthAwareLogger, Logger
public abstract class AbstractFilteringLogger extends Object implements Logger, LoggerDecoratorService.DepthAwareLogger
A base class for LoggerDecoratorService implementations that need to filter or enrich log calls without depending on AbstractLogger's internal dispatch, whose stack depth to the real caller is an unversioned SLF4J implementation detail rather than something Rainbow Gum controls or tests.

Every convenience method (info(String), error(String,Object), marker variants, ...) funnels through exactly one internal dispatch method before isEnabled(Level, Marker) and decorate(LoggingEventBuilder, Marker) run, so the frame count from any convenience method to caller-info capture is fixed and verified once by this class's own tests. Subclasses never need to reason about stack depth. Non-marker convenience methods pass a null marker to both hooks.

The fluent atInfo() style API (makeLoggingEventBuilder(Level)) is a transparent pass-through to delegate() and does not invoke either hook, since there is no populated event (or marker) to filter or decorate yet at that point.

See Also:
  • LoggerDecoratorService for a full example and how to register a decorator.

    Logger
    withDepth(int depth)
    A no-op: unlike AbstractLogger-based decorators, this class's caller-info depth is a fixed internal constant rather than derived from the wrap-count LoggerDecoratorService.decorate(RainbowGum, DepthAwareLogger, int) passes in, so there is nothing to recreate.
